text:
sanjay: Heads-up, inbound from Acme: they want a temporary onboarding package — 90d pilot with a 2x burst allowance + $30k onboarding credit. Need product decision for roadmap.
kelly: Do we have precedent for timed credits + burst?
mike: We've done short promo credits but not burst allowances tied to commits. Major ops risk for hosted API.
sales-raj: Customer insists it's a hard requirement for pilot. They're willing to sign a strict pilot clause. Need us to move quickly.
anne: Proposal: MVP = console softcap alerts + automatic credit application + ops runbook. No auto-throttle for pilot. Stretch = auto-fallback routing & SLA add-on.
legal-bot: Suggested language: "Pilot credits expire after 90 days and're non-transferable; we reserve the right to throttle or fallback for platform protection." Also request: customer agrees to provide usage pattern logs upon request.
finance-sara: Quick calc: if burst utilized 25% of time, incremental cost ~ $15k/mo. $30k credit covers first ~2 months of burst. Need a P&L summary before we sign.
eng-lina: Tech notes: softcap + billing tag is small work (1-2 dev days). Routing fallback needs model-compatibility checks + canary testing (2-3 sprints).
kelly: Can we ship MVP early and mark fallback as a conditional engineering sprint if pilot shows need?
mike: Ops will be on standby if Sales accepts that risk. We should require a hard cap on total free credit usage (e.g., $30k max).
anne: Gate for GA: no severity >=P2 incidents during pilot and unit token cost <= threshold T. Otherwise revert to non-burst behavior.
sales-raj: I'll confirm with Acme they accept pilot constraints and may sign a waiver for SLA during pilot.
legal-bot: Also recommend adding a clause that sustained overage can be billed at list rates if we can't contain costs.
finance-sara: I'll run a 90d P&L stub and post results by EOD.
sanjay: Assignments: Anne -> draft MVP spec; Eng-Lina -> spike estimate for fallback; Legal -> draft pilot clause; Finance -> P&L stub; Sales-Raj -> customer acceptance. Back here in 24h. :thumbsup:
